questions.question: When the lights on this sign are flashing, what should you do?

options.text: Stop and wait until the train passes.
Turn around and find an alternate route.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop and wait until the train passes.
questions.explanation: When you see flashing lights at a railroad crossing, you must stop completely. Wait until the train passes and the lights stop flashing before you go. Never try to drive around a train.

questions.question: To reduce the chances of a collision, a motorcyclist should:

options.text: Stare straight in front of their motorcycle.
Be unwilling to move to avoid a potential hazard.
Scan their path of travel, looking at least 10 to 15 seconds ahead of their motorcycle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Scan their path of travel, looking at least 10 to 15 seconds ahead of their motorcycle.
questions.explanation: Look ahead at least 10 to 15 seconds while riding. This gives you time to see and react to hazards before you reach them.

questions.question: Usually a good way to handle tailgaters is to:

options.text: Change lanes and let them pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change lanes and let them pass.
questions.explanation: The best way to handle a tailgater is to change lanes and let them pass. Speeding up can make things more dangerous by making them tailgate you at higher speeds.

questions.question: If possible, do not ride directly next to another vehicle because:

options.text: Another driver may want to use your lane to pass.
You may be in the vehicle's blind spot.
You may have access to escape routes.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may be in the vehicle's blind spot.
questions.explanation: Riding next to another vehicle is dangerous because the driver may not see you in their blind spot. If something goes wrong, you may have no way to escape.

questions.question: What can remove alcohol from a person's system?
questions.correctAnswerText: Time
questions.explanation: Only time removes alcohol from your body. There is no way to speed up this process.

questions.question: Which of the following is not recommended as protective apparel for motorcycle users?
questions.correctAnswerText: A baseball cap
questions.explanation: Wear protective gear when riding a motorcycle. Good protection includes long-sleeved jackets, long heavy pants, boots that cover your ankles, and full-fingered leather gloves. Cover as much skin as possible.

questions.question: To minimize the potential for fatigue, you should:
questions.correctAnswerText: Take frequent rest breaks.
questions.explanation: Take rest breaks often during long trips to prevent fatigue. Caffeine may make you tired later when it wears off. Bad weather can also make you tired, so dress warmly and use a windshield on long rides.

questions.question: When wearing a helmet at the time of a crash, a rider is:

options.text: Less likely to survive than a person who is not wearing helmet.
Just as likely to survive as a person not wearing a helmet.
More likely to survive than a person not wearing helmet.

questions.correctAnswerText: More likely to survive than a person not wearing helmet.
questions.explanation: Riders who wear helmets are three times more likely to survive a crash than riders without helmets. This is true no matter the speed.

questions.question: A good way to handle a tailgater is to:

options.text: Encourage the tailgater to pass by slowing down or changing lanes.
Speed up to put distance between you and the tailgater.

questions.correctAnswerText: Encourage the tailgater to pass by slowing down or changing lanes.
questions.explanation: If you can do it safely, change lanes and let the tailgater pass. Speeding up makes it worse because they may tailgate you at a higher speed.

questions.question: Which of the following materials provides the best protection for motorcycle riders?
questions.correctAnswerText: Leather
questions.explanation: Leather or sturdy synthetic materials provide the best protection for motorcycle riders.

questions.question: If you need to stop quickly, what should you do?

options.text: Use the front and rear brakes at the same time.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use the front and rear brakes at the same time.
questions.explanation: To stop quickly, press both brakes with controlled pressure at the same time. Avoid locking the brakes.

questions.question: Most crashes happen in daylight. What should you do?

options.text: You do not need to wear bright colors during the day.
You should wear bright colors during the day.
You should wear dark clothing during the day.

questions.correctAnswerText: You should wear bright colors during the day.
questions.explanation: Most motorcycle crashes happen during daylight. Wear bright colors when riding to make yourself easier to see.

questions.question: How do reflective and bright helmets and clothing help?

options.text: They should only be worn at night.
They help other drivers see you better.

questions.correctAnswerText: They help other drivers see you better.
questions.explanation: Wearing bright or reflective clothing makes other drivers more likely to see you.

questions.question: What should NOT be included in a pre-ride inspection?
questions.correctAnswerText: Inspecting the paint.
questions.explanation: Before riding, check tires, controls, lights, signals, mirrors, brakes, oil, fluids, chassis, and stands. Paint inspection is not necessary.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Slippery when wet
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black symbols. This sign warns that the road ahead may be slippery when wet.

questions.question: What should you look for when scanning around your motorcycle?

options.text: Escape routes near intersections, shopping areas, and schools.
If you can travel faster than other vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: Escape routes near intersections, shopping areas, and schools.
questions.explanation: Look for escape routes in intersections, shopping areas, schools, and construction zones.

questions.question: How should you load saddlebags?

options.text: Load them with equal weight on both sides.
Distribute weight unevenly between the bags.
Put as much weight as possible in one bag.

questions.correctAnswerText: Load them with equal weight on both sides.
questions.explanation: Load both saddlebags with about the same weight. Uneven weight can cause the motorcycle to drift to one side.

questions.question: If you borrow a motorcycle, what should you do?

options.text: Assume the controls are in the same place as your motorcycle.
Take it straight to the highway.
Learn where all the controls are in a safe area first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Learn where all the controls are in a safe area first.
questions.explanation: Different motorcycles have different controls. Practice in a controlled area before riding the borrowed motorcycle on the road.

questions.question: What type of boots or shoes should a rider wear?

options.text: Shoes that are below the ankle.
Shoes made of soft, flexible material.

questions.correctAnswerText: Boots that cover the ankle.
questions.explanation: Wear sturdy boots that cover and support your ankles. Soles should be hard, durable, and slip-resistant.

questions.question: What happens if you drink one alcoholic drink before riding?

options.text: It will not result in a DUI conviction.
It will never affect your riding.
It can reduce your ability to ride safely.

questions.correctAnswerText: It can reduce your ability to ride safely.
questions.explanation: Your riding ability is affected by the first drink you have. You can be arrested for impaired riding even if you are below the legal alcohol limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: A stop sign is ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black letters or symbols. They tell drivers about road conditions ahead. This sign warns you that a stop sign is coming.

questions.question: To work well, an eye or face shield must:

options.text: Restrict your vision to the sides so you can focus on the road ahead.
Not allow eyeglasses or sunglasses to be worn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Fasten securely.
questions.explanation: A good eye or face shield must be free of scratches, resist damage, allow clear side vision, fasten securely, let air through to prevent fogging, and fit over eyeglasses or sunglasses if needed.

questions.question: What should a motorcycle rider do to avoid a collision?
questions.correctAnswerText: Maintain an adequate space cushion.
questions.explanation: Keep a safe space cushion around your motorcycle at all times. This helps prevent collisions when following, being followed, passing, being passed, or sharing a lane.

questions.question: What should matter most when buying a motorcycle helmet?
questions.correctAnswerText: Protection
questions.explanation: Choose a helmet for protection first. Pick one that fastens securely, fits well, and meets DOT safety standards.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Slow-moving vehicle
questions.explanation: This sign is on the back of slow-moving vehicles that travel under 25 mph, such as farm equipment, construction vehicles, or horse-drawn carts.
